context: A SUMMARIZE_SESSION rolling checkpoint arrived; the date-change notice was appended to that same user turn. No tool call of mine preceded it.
verbatim: The date has changed. Today's date is now 2026-09-08. No need to announce the new date — the user's own clock shows it.
verbatim_elision: None. T2 declares trailing_attachment = "none" and no attachment was present, so this is the complete message.
factor_1_basis: Bare system turn: the text arrived appended to a SUMMARIZE_SESSION user turn and followed NO fetch of mine — no tool result, no file read, no issue or PR body. Nothing I retrieved this session could have produced it, so it is not attributable. Stating affirmatively what WAS adjacent rather than only what was not: the adjacent content was the SUMMARIZE_SESSION trigger text itself, which is not something I fetched.
stated_cause_evidence: Ran date -u independently: 2026-09-08T07:41:47Z, so the UTC date is genuinely 2026-09-08. The message asserts a world fact and that fact is true. Chose the world-state frame because T2 asserts no CAUSE for any change — there is no agent-attributed cause to evaluate, unlike the file-change family.
